citations.A1: Cache set once, never invalidated after first load — fix: check the file's mtime (or hash) each call and reload when it changes.
citations.A2: Tempting fix "add a TTL and reload every N seconds" — doesn't address it: still serves stale data for up to N seconds
citations.A3: Tempting fix "just remove the cache and always read the file" — not root-cause-correct: reintroduces disk I/O on every call
